signature: Your childhood bedroom at nine to twelve, lit a dim sterile white, with the same blue floral single bed for everyone, grins waiting in the dark under it, mould creeping across the ceiling, and a door left ajar onto an infinite black void with a M.E.G. rope tied to the knob.

exits.source_quote: Fall asleep in this room, and you will awake on a street on Level 9 .
exits.label: Fell asleep on the blue floral bed and woke on a street
exits.hint: The bed is the one thing that is the same for everyone. Lie down; it is hard to stay awake in this light.

exits.method: Say 'I'm so bored...' in a dull voice
exits.source_quote: Saying "I'm so bored…" in a dull voice leads you to Level 25 .
exits.label: Said "I'm so bored..." in a dull voice
exits.hint: Nothing here works. Nothing here happens. Say so.

exits.method: Doorway to void: infinite drift, death by dehydration
exits.source_quote: wanderers who fall out of reach of the doorway will continue drifting down into the darkness
exits.label: Drifted beyond the rope into the void (not a level exit)
exits.hint: The rope is about 150 yards long.

notes: SOURCE: childhood bedroom of a 9-12 year old, desynchronous (one wanderer); arrival in the doorway facing in, door behind slightly ajar onto a black void; the same single bed (wooden frame, blue floral sheet) with bed bugs; appliances dead, brought devices work (flashlight allowed); the light switch is the only working appliance, on by default, dim sterile white; Smilers under the bed and in dark spaces emerge if the light goes off; void enterable, breathable, low gravity, no swimming up; ~150 yd (137 m) M.E.G. rope tied to the doorknob; Stress Mould on walls/ceiling grows, hazardous after ~8 h; windows only if the childhood room had them; no bases; exits: sleep -> Level 9 street, 'I'm so bored...' in a dull voice -> Level 25. ADAPTATION: the room is seeded (size 3.7-4.4 x 4.4-5.1 m, 2.42-2.56 m ceiling, window 60%, furniture) because every wanderer's room differs; 70% of seeds fuse a second childhood room (other wallpaper and floor) through the east wall at +0.36/+0.54/-0.36 m (2-3 steps) for 'several rooms fused together erratically'; generic childhood-room furniture (school desk and chair, bookshelf, nightstand, dresser, toy crates, closet with white sliding doors) is ours - interview details (pink stool, poster, duck lamp) are testimony and are not used; one in-room hour = 45 s of play for mould growth; Smilers attack for 30 health every 3 s after 6.5 s of darkness (no combat); the door swings wide when you step onto the threshold and the rope hangs from its outer knob; reaching the top of the rope hauls you over the threshold; drifting 2.5 m below the rope's end blacks out and kills (the source's dehydration, compressed). The edge L114>EXT#3 is kept as declared but implemented as a fail state, not a trigger: the void has no destination. The shared DEV26 annex cues are relocated by the level into the room (on_player_ready). QA fixture: the doze takes 1.2 s instead of 7 s.
entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Smilers (grins in the dark under the bed and in the closet gap; emerge only while the light is off), Stress Mould (growing patches), window counterparts (only when the seeded room has a window), bed bugs (bites when lying down). The void stays empty, as the page says.

fail_states.label: Drifting below the end of the 137 m M.E.G. rope: lost in the void
fail_states.source_quote: it is assumed that those lost within eventually die of dehydration

fail_states.label: Smilers emerge and attack while the light is off
fail_states.source_quote: turning off the lights in the room will allow them to emerge

fail_states.label: Stress Mould becomes hazardous after about eight hours
fail_states.source_quote: levels of mould in the room exceed safety limits after approximately 8 hours

fail_states.label: Touching a window replaced by its malevolent counterpart
fail_states.source_quote: The windows in the room are occasionally replaced by their malevolent liminal counterparts.
